prompts.en: Create a wide 16:9 game library banner adapted from the attached original classic box scan. Use the scan as visual reference, preserving the painted classic character identities, costumes, palette, skull/pirate setting, and period illustration style. Recompose horizontally without stretching the portrait or cropping faces. Main characters on right half, evocative background on left behind clearly readable title "The Secret of Monkey Island" with smaller "CLASSIC". Match the original cover's lettering design. Remove box edges, wear, platform stickers, publisher badges and fine print. This is the classic edition, do not use remastered character designs. Keep title inside central 80% safe area. Polished flat artwork, not a box mockup.
